Name: JP's Text Effects for Dialogs Framework
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][b][i][color=#00ff00][size=6][u]Text Effects Mod[/u][/size][/color][/i][/b][/font][/center]


[font=Georgia][b][i][color=#ff00ff][size=5]Inspired by the special effects used in the game “Celeste,” here is a collection of over 40 special effects to use in your dialogues to make your stories more immersive![/size][/color][/i][/b][/font]


[font=Georgia][b][size=4]This mod lets you add special codes to your I18n or regular text to apply special effects to your characters' in-game dialogue (THIS ONLY AFFECTS DIALOGUE WITHIN THE DIALOG BOX, NOT TEXT ABOVE THE CHARACTER'S HEAD OR SIMILAR TEXT). [/size][/b][/font]
[font=Georgia][b][size=4][color=#ffff00]You can enclose either a single word or a complete sentence in tags, depending on your design. [/color][/size][/b][/font]

[font=Georgia][size=4][b]All code tags follow the same format: an opening tag, text in the middle, and a closing tag: [/b][/size][/font]
[color=#00ffff][size=4][font=Georgia][b][cod]text example[/cod].[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[font=Georgia]
[i][color=#00ff00][size=4]Below is the complete list of tags you can use in your dialogues. Simply wrap the text you want to modify with the opening and closing tags.[/size][/color][/i]

[size=3][b]* **Bold:** `[color=#00ffff][bld]text[/bld][/color]` - Makes the text bold, thicker, and slightly larger for emphasis.[/b][/size][/font]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/yNz53Qx8/Bold.gif[/img]
[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b]* **Rainbow:** `[color=#00ffff][rbw]text[/rbw][/color]` - Colors transition smoothly and continuously through a vibrant rainbow spectrum.[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/gJgB5GDr/Rainbow.gif[/img]
[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b]* **Gold:** `[color=#00ffff][gld]text[/gld][/color]` - Gives the text a shiny, shifting golden glow, perfect for treasures or rare items.
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W3NHXdMb/Gold.gif[/img]
[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b]* **Fade In:** `[color=#00ffff][fi]text[/fi][/color]` - Text starts completely invisible and slowly fades into view.[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/rpLbRnsQ/Fade-In.gif[/img][/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b]
* **Fade Out:** `[color=#00ffff][fo]text[/fo][/color]` - Text appears normally, but slowly fades away and disappears over time.[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/hGbYLLQw/Fade-Out.gif[/img][/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b]
* **Ghostly:** `[color=#00ffff][gst]text[/gst][/color]` - Text turns a pale, eerie white and its opacity pulses gently over time.
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/d0mf22TJ/Ghost.gif[/img]
[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b]* **Wave:** `[color=#00ffff][wve]text[/wve][/color]` - Letters smoothly undulate up and down in a classic, relaxing sine wave.[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/Kz0sVmNg/Wave.gif[/img][/b][/font][/size]

[b][font=Georgia]* **Shake:** `[color=#00ffff][shk]text[/shk][/color]` or `[color=#00ffff][shk:X]text[/shk][/color]` - Text vibrates in place. Supports intensities from 1 to 3 (e.g., `[color=#00ffff][shk:1][/color]` for a subtle quiver, `[color=#00ffff][shk:3][/color]` for a violent scream). Default is 2.[/font][/b]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/XJsDhn85/Shake.gif[/img]
[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b]* **Growth:** `[color=#00ffff][grw]text[/grw][/color]` - Letters start extremely small and spring to their full size with a satisfying elastic bounce.[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/cHxbXvQK/Growth.gif[/img]
[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b]* **Gravity / Fall:** `[color=#00ffff][fal]text[/fal][/color]` - After a brief delay, the letters lose their grip and fall downwards off the screen with real physics and rotation.
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/hjD5pXVN/Fall.gif[/img]
[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b]* **Replace:** `[color=#00ffff][rep:NewWord]OriginalText[/rep][/color]` - A seamless bait-and-switch. After a moment, the original text dissolves and is replaced by the new text with perfect dynamic spacing.[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/pTs17PZ9/Replace.gif[/img][/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b]
* **Glitch:** `[color=#00ffff][glc]text[/glc][/color]` - Text rapidly stutters, randomly changing characters and flashing cyan/red like a broken terminal.[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/C1hQmRbW/Glitch.gif[/img]
[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b]* **Explosion:** `[color=#00ffff][exp]text[/exp][/color]` - Text shakes violently, turns red, and then shatters outward in random directions.[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/7LycJshb/Explosion.gif[/img]
[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b]* **Broken:** `[color=#00ffff][brk]text[/brk][/color]` - Text appears shattered, turns gray, and plays a hammering sound effect as each letter is typed.[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zf1MHtvf/Broken.gif[/img]
[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b]* **Censor / Secret:** `[color=#00ffff][scr]text[/scr][/color]` - Text is hidden behind black blocks (like a redacted document) and is only revealed when the player hovers their mouse over it.[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/q7dY6bqz/Censor.gif[/img][/b][/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Georgia][b]* **Matrix:** `[color=#00ffff][mtx]text[/mtx][/color]` - Letters rapidly cycle through random ASCII characters in neon green before stabilizing into the real text.[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b]
* **Hop:** `[color=#00ffff][jmp]text[/jmp][/color]` - Each letter happily jumps up and down in a continuous, cheerful wave.[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b]
* **Wind:** `[color=#00ffff][wnd]text[/wnd][/color]` - Text bends and leans to the side, pivoting from the bottom to react to unpredictable, invisible gusts of wind.[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b]
* **Heartbeat:** `[color=#00ffff][hrt]text[/hrt][/color]` - Text pulses in size and flashes red, perfectly mimicking the double-beat rhythm of a heart.[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b]
* **Breath:** `[color=#00ffff][brt]text[/brt][/color]` or `[color=#00ffff][brt:X]text[/brt][/color]` - Text gently expands and contracts like breathing lungs. Supports speed modifiers from 1 (slow) to 3 (fast).[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b]
* **Drunk:** `[color=#00ffff][drk]text[/drk][/color]` - Letters tilt and sway unevenly, simulating a dizzy, disoriented, or intoxicated state.[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b]
* **Shiver / Cold:** `[color=#00ffff][cld]text[/cld][/color]` - Text turns pale icy blue and chatters left and right rapidly as if freezing.[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b]
* **Assemble:** `[color=#00ffff][asm]text[/asm][/color]` - Pauses the dialogue typing. Each letter flies in from completely random, far-off coordinates to perfectly and cinematically assemble the word on screen.[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b]
* **Typo:** `[color=#00ffff][typ]text[/typ][/color]` - Simulates typing mistakes. Random wrong characters appear and are "deleted" with a backspace sound before the real letter is typed.[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b]
* **Eat:** `[color=#00ffff][eat]text[/eat][/color]` - The first letter of the block jumps up and physically "devours" the subsequent letters one by one in a bouncing animation.[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b]
* **Ascension:** `[color=#00ffff][srp]text[/srp][/color]` - Letters glow bright white and slowly float upwards toward the heavens before fading.[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b]
* **Fade In/Out:** `[color=#00ffff][fio]text[/fio][/color]` - Text continuously pulses between visible and invisible in a smooth loop.[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b]
 * **Blood:** `[color=#00ffff][ble]text[/ble][/color]` - The text throbs in a deep crimson red, and physical blood droplets periodically drip down from the letters to the bottom of the dialogue box.[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b]
* **Amnesia:** `[color=#00ffff][amn]text[/amn][/color]` - Letters appear normally, but slowly and inevitably dissolve into nothingness one by one, mimicking memory loss.[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b]
* **Paranoia:** `[color=#00ffff][whi]text[/whi][/color]` - Dark cyan or crimson ghost silhouettes of the text aggressively flash and expand in the background for a fraction of a second.[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b]
* **Zero Gravity:** `[color=#00ffff][zro]text[/zro][/color]` - After a few seconds, the text loses its anchor, slowly drifting and rotating into the void of space before fading out completely.[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b]
* **Upside Down:** `[color=#00ffff][ups]text[/ups][/color]` - Rotates the text 180 degrees to be completely upside down, perfectly aligned to the text baseline.[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b]
* **Reverse:** `[color=#00ffff][rev]text[/rev][/color]` - The physical placement of the letters is mirrored backwards (e.g., "Hello" reads as "olleH") without breaking internal indexing or other effects.[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b]
* **Speed:** `[color=#00ffff][spd:X]text[/spd][/color]` - Modifies the typing speed of the dialogue engine for the enclosed text (e.g., `[color=#00ffff][spd:0.5][/color]` for fast text, `[color=#00ffff][spd:2.5][/color]` for slow text).[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Georgia][b]
* **Translocate (Soft):** `[color=#00ffff][ts1]text1[/ts1][/color]` and `[color=#00ffff][ts2]text2[/ts2][/color]` - Smoothly and visually swaps the positions of two groups of text over time.[/b][/font][/size]
